title: Monsoon and Trail
author: S. M. Zhou
blurb: Oscar Montrose, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
